# Prakhar Sharma, AI Engineer

> Portfolio of Prakhar Sharma, AI Engineer at The Odin (Jaipur, India). Production
> LLM systems: RAG pipelines, autonomous voice agents, and deterministic schedulers
> wrapped in guardrails. Open to AI engineering roles in Bengaluru or remote.

This is a single-page static site. Every fact below restates copy already on the page.

## Work

- Dharwin: multi-tenant AI-powered ATS/HRM SaaS, in production. Pinecone RAG
  knowledge base with grounded-count validation; autonomous voice agents call
  candidates, run screening interviews, and write structured results back into
  the ATS. 99 data models, 77 REST modules, 1,200+ commits in six months.
- Religence: pharma lead discovery and CRM. A containerized FastAPI crawler
  classifies prospect websites with OpenAI structured outputs and Google Places
  enrichment; the TypeScript CRM adds verification queues, an in-app Outlook
  inbox over Microsoft Graph delta sync, and an LLM mail-scheduling agent where
  the LLM writes a versioned contract and a deterministic claim/lease scheduler
  sends each run exactly once with per-run idempotency keys.
- Also shipped: voice screening agents (Bolna, OpenAI), the PROWPLUS project
  and support portal, and a Gemini legal document generator with structured
  outputs and function calling.

## Experience

- AI Engineer, The Odin, Jaipur, Nov 2025 to present. Production RAG pipelines
  with a post-LLM grounding validator, autonomous voice agents, versioned system
  prompts and guardrails, BullMQ queues with dead-letter queues, the
  transactional outbox pattern, and webhook idempotency guards.

## Stack

- Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, TypeScript, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS,
  Azure and Microsoft Graph; OpenAI, Google Gemini, LangChain, LlamaIndex,
  Pinecone; Next.js and React.
